ms.promise:
Implement the fundamental on-chain components of the OToken Donation Platform, building upon the technical specifications outlined in Milestone 1. During this phase, the Strategy Vault, Donation/Yield Distribution Module, and NFT Minting Module will be developed and demonstrated via testnet or beta mainnet deployments.
・Core Smart Contract Implementation
・Strategy Vault (Staked OToken): Manages staked OTOKEN and leverages internal or external yield strategies to grow donated assets. Integrates with external protocols handling yield generation (manual or automated) as per system design.
・Donation/Yield Distribution Module: Receives donations in OTOKEN (or other configured assets) and orchestrates yield distribution among designated beneficiaries. Ensures accurate allocation of generated yield from the Strategy Vault, preserving transparency and auditability.
・NFT Minting Module: On-chain mechanism for minting NFTs that acknowledge user contributions. Defines metadata standards and minting conditions in line with the system design.
・﻿﻿Code Walkthrough Video
・Video of code walkthrough to describe the smart contract mechanism and working live interactions of a private testnet or limite
ms.criteria:
・Core Smart Contract Implementation
・GitHub Repository: A publicly accessible repository containing implementations of contracts for the Strategy Vault, Donation/Yield Distribution Module, and NFT Minting Module
・Alignment with Milestone 1: Code structured to reflect the architectural principles laid out in the original system design specification.
・Validation: Demonstrations on the Cardano testnet or mainnet beta confirming that yield distribution and NFT minting function correctly (e.g., transferring funds, minting tokens).
・Code Walkthrough Video
・Architectural Overview: A lead developer pr

ms.promise:
Leverage the Figma design boards to develop a responsive, user friendly web interface for the OToken Donation Platform. This milestone focuses on translating approved UX/UI designs into a production grade frontend and initiating integrations with Switzerland for UNHCR’s systems. A recorded demo will showcase the working application, highlighting its core modules and user interactions.
・Functional Donor Interface
・Frontend: Implementing the latest best practices in JavaScript development, including modular React components and optional server-side rendering. 
・User Focused Interactions: Integrated wallet connections, donation flows, and NFT interactions, providing a frictionless experience for donors.
・Admin Dashboard Integration
・Admin Panel: An interface for UN personnel to monitor system participation and view current UN donation addresses that donor funds are sent to. 
・Basic Integration: Initial data exchange with Switzerland for UNHCR’s, ensuring that key administrative functions (e.g., viewing system participation, updating donation data) are accessible. 
・Video Demo
・Test Deployment Walkthrough: A recorded demonstration of the working dApp frontend in a staging or test envir
ms.criteria:
・Functional Donor Interface
・Conformity with Approved Figma Boards: The frontend should visually and functionally match the final UI designs, reflecting correct branding, layout, and user flows.
・Admin Dashboard Integration
・Functional Admin Dashboard: Basic but operational admin features linked with Switzerland for UNHCR systems, tested against relevant use cases (e.g., donation recipient address (UNHCR), viewing donation/ donor summaries).
・Video Demo
・Frontend Showcase: A clearly narrated presentation demonstrating essential features, from user login and wallet connection to donation asset
